## Overview
### Introduction to Qwen: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B
Qwen: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B is a standard, non-open-source model provided by Qwen, released on January 1, 2024. This model boasts an impressive architecture, with a context window of 262,144 tokens and a maximum output of 65,536 tokens. The knowledge cutoff for this model is December 2023, ensuring it has a broad and up-to-date understanding of the world. With capabilities including text, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, and structured outputs, Qwen: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B is a versatile tool for developers.

### Strengths and Use Cases
The primary strengths of Qwen: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B lie in its ability to handle a wide range of tasks, including chat, text generation, coding, analysis, RAG pipelines, and summarization. Its high MMLU benchmark score of 87.0 and LMSYS Arena ELO score of 1270 demonstrate its effectiveness in these areas. Developers can leverage this model for various applications, from generating human-like text to assisting with coding tasks. The pricing model, which includes input costs of $0.26 per 1M tokens and output costs of $2.08 per 1M tokens, allows for flexible and cost-effective use. For example, 1,000 calls with an average of 500 tokens would cost approximately $0.0012.

### Technical Details and Cost Considerations
